function.name: set_operating_frequency
function.description: Adjust the ESP target operating frequency (Hz) via VFD control. OP00 Operational Control.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset (e.g., 'ESP-Well-001')

target_frequency_hz.description: Target electrical drive frequency in Hertz (Hz), e.g., 55.0

function.name: get_asset_status
function.description: Retrieve current operating status, live sensor telemetry, and engineering state for an ESP asset. OP01 Current Status.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset

function.name: analyze_production_decline
function.description: Perform production decline root cause analysis (RCA) comparing current flow rates with operating envelopes. OP02 Production Decline RCA.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset

function.name: diagnose_fault
function.description: Diagnose downhole ESP equipment electrical and mechanical faults based on telemetry symptoms. OP03 Fault Diagnosis.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset

symptom.description: Observed symptom, trip code, or anomaly description (e.g., 'motor overheating', 'underload trip')

function.name: get_health_index
function.description: Compute and retrieve composite health index (0-100) and remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. OP04 Health Assessment.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset

function.name: check_early_warnings
function.description: Evaluate leading indicators and multi-sensor trends for early warning fault detection before trip thresholds are breached. OP05 Early Warning.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset

function.name: lookup_sop_procedure
function.description: Query technical standards and standard operating procedures (SOP) from the deterministic knowledge base. OP06 Procedure Lookup.

query.description: Search query describing the procedure, operational protocol, or limit lookup

standard.description: Governing operational standard, standard code, or procedure category (e.g., 'CCED_ESP_SOP_REV3', 'API_RP_11S')

function.name: general_inquiry
function.description: Answer general domain inquiries, terminology definitions, and conceptual questions regarding artificial lift. OP07 General Inquiry.

query.description: The general inquiry question or concept to explain

function.name: get_fleet_inventory
function.description: Retrieve global fleet inventory status, asset classifications, and operational distribution across all fields. OP08 Fleet Inventory.

function.name: get_fleet_production_optimization
function.description: Aggregate fleet-level production optimization opportunities, choke/frequency adjustment candidates, and uplift potential. OP09 Fleet Production Optimization.

function.name: get_fleet_design_sizing
function.description: Perform fleet-wide ESP design sizing validation, pump stage suitability checks, and BEP alignment analysis. OP10 Fleet Design Sizing.

function.name: get_fleet_maintenance_priority
function.description: Generate prioritized maintenance ranking, workover urgency scoring, and intervention recommendations across the fleet. OP11 Fleet Maintenance Priority.

function.name: get_fleet_case_analytics
function.description: Analyze historical fleet incident patterns, mean time between failures (MTBF), and recurring trip causes across wells. OP12 Fleet Case Analytics.

function.name: get_fleet_executive_report
function.description: Compile executive summary dashboard including fleet health distribution, production vs target, and high-risk wells. OP13 Fleet Executive Report.

function.name: get_operational_history
function.description: Retrieve operational history, historian sensor time-series, and trip log records for an asset over a specified time window. OP14 Operational History.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset

range.description: Time range window for historical telemetry (e.g., '1h', '6h', '24h', '7d', '30d')

function.name: ask_clarification
function.description: Formulate a targeted clarification question back to the operator when intent is ambiguous or required context is missing.

question.description: Clarification question presented to the user

missing_context.description: Explanation of the missing parameters or ambiguous context needed

function.name: get_agent_profile
function.description: Inspect agent capabilities, specialist team structure, operational constraints, and version metadata.

function.name: explain_widget
function.description: Explain the chart or SCADA visualization visible on the operator screen: governing physics, standards citation, on-screen title, and live operating state.

widget_id.description: Widget slug or on-screen title (e.g. 'pump-curve', 'operating-envelope', 'forensics-timeline', or 'ESP Pump Performance Curve')

function.name: get_ml_results
function.description: Query the latest machine learning classification verdicts, health scores, and anomaly detections from mlresults.db for an ESP asset.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP asset (e.g. 'FS-031')

limit.description: Maximum number of recent ML results to return (default 10)

function.name: render_visual
function.description: Renders an interactive engineering visualization, multi-parameter strip chart, or digital twin component in the chat deck as visual evidence.

widget_id.description: Identifier of visual component to render: 'forensics-timeline' (Visual 1: Synchronized Dynamic Tipping Timeline), 'subsystem-equalizer' (Visual 2: Subsystem Health Equalizer & Depth Pressure Profile), 'pump-curve' (Visual 3: In-Situ H-Q Pump Performance Curve & BEP Drift), 'operating-envelope' (Visual 4: P10-P90 Statistical Boundary Monitoring), 'synchronized-trends' (Multi-Parameter Synchronized Trends), or 'well-schematic' (Downhole Well Schematic Digital Twin).
